Complete [[Blood Washes Blood]].
==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Kill the [[Charr]] trespassers on [[Jora]]'s homeland in [[Bjora Marches]].
* *BONUS* Complete the mission in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 3,000 [[Experience]]
* 500 [[Gold]]
* 1,500 [[Norn reputation point]]s
* Complete the Base Objective for 30 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 75 Zaishen Copper Coins.

==Walkthrough==
As per [[Blood_Washes_Blood#Walkthrough|Blood Washes Blood walkthrough]].

==Dialogues==
===Initial dialogue===
'''Zaishen Mission'''
:''"I, Jora, seek a strong hunting party to reclaim my homestead from the Charr. The Bear Spirit in Jaga Moraine will guide you to me."''
{{offer dialogue
|accept = I can do that!
|decline = No, I'm way too busy today.
|ask = The battle rages on! All able-bodied heroes should hasten to defend those bravely protecting [[Tyria (world)|Tyria]]. }}

===Reward dialogue===
'''Zehnchu'''
:''"Excellent work! The Zaishen admire your dedication."''

==Trivia==
*This was the first [[Zaishen Mission]] when it was introduced in the Guild Wars 4th Birthday Celebration update in April 2009.
